title: Public online backup progress observers

scope.rationale: The remaining and page-count APIs expose the stable progress snapshot written by the most recent backup step without advancing, allocating, or locking the backup owner.
excluded_responsibilities: Backup initialization stepping finishing and restart

external_source_responsibilities: Production Backup progress fields written by sqlite3_backup_step
dependencies.caller_closure: Both assigned canonical public exports read the production online-backup owner.

outputs: Most recently published remaining-page or total-page count, or zero under API armor for null
contracts.ownership: Borrowed backup handle; no allocation, release, or transfer.
contracts.state_and_results: Observers do not advance a step. Restart preserves the previous snapshot until the next step recomputes both values.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: No lock, callback, or I/O; source documents these progress observations as the most recent step snapshot.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Null returns zero. Live handles remain unchanged and step/finish continuation is unaffected.

representation_differences: Native Backup stores c_int progress directly after deriving it from the selected source Pager page size and retained snapshot.

oracle.protocol: Initialize a backup, inspect zero initial progress, perform bounded and completing steps, mutate/restart the source, and compare remaining/page-count snapshots through finish.
internal_observations: restart-pending preservation before the next step
oracle.normalization: Compare exact public integer observations at each step boundary.

assurance.oom: No allocation; reports the prior snapshot after any failed step.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No direct I/O or lock; valid-handle concurrent use follows the public backup API contract.
assurance.malformed_input: Null handle returns zero under active API armor behavior.
assurance.continuation: Observation does not alter stepping, restart, or finish behavior.

integration.native_call_path: Canonical public exports read progress populated by the production attached-schema-capable backup step.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: Yes. The observers have no separate progress model.

independent_review.notes: Pinned-C internal trace, assurance, and independent review remain open.
